instruction: Set the default font size to 14pt in LibreOffice Writer.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully changed the default font to Times New Roman by navigating to Tools > Options > LibreOffice Writer > Basic Fonts (Western) and modifying the Default font field.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Writer Options dialog, find Basic Fonts settings, select fonts from dropdown, apply and confirm changes.
metadata.task_rationale: Targets the font size field instead of font name, testing whether the model can modify a different property in the same settings panel.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default font size to 14pt. Custom metric find_default_font_size parses registrymodifications.xcu for the Height property under /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont/Standard, converting from internal units (hundredths of a point) to points before comparing. [Fixed: corrected XPath from DefaultFont/StandardHeight to DefaultFont/Standard/Height, added unit conversion from hundredths-of-point to points]
fix_history: Fix 1: Corrected XPath from oor:path='/org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont' + prop 'StandardHeight' to oor:path='/org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont/Standard' + prop 'Height'
Fix 2: Added unit conversion in metric - LibreOffice stores font sizes in hundredths of a point (14pt=1400), metric now divides by 100 before comparing against expected value in points
Fix 3: Fixed value element search to not use namespace (value elements in registrymodifications.xcu have no namespace prefix)
metadata.verification: Re-verified after fix: metric now searches correct XPath and converts 1400 (internal units) / 100 = 14.0 == 14 (expected), returning score 1

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches registrymodifications.xcu from the VM, which is the right file for LibreOffice Writer default settings.

Metric uses correct XPath: searches for item with oor:path='/org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont/Standard' and property oor:name='Height', which matches the actual registrymodifications.xcu structure for default font size.
Unit conversion is correctly implemented: LibreOffice stores font sizes in hundredths of a point (14pt = 1400), and the metric divides by 100 before comparing against the expected value of 14.
Value element search correctly omits namespace prefix, matching the actual XML structure where value elements have no namespace.
The instruction has a single requirement (set default font size to 14pt) and the evaluator fully verifies it.
Previous issues (wrong XPath, missing unit conversion, namespace on value elements) have all been fixed as documented in fix_history.
